text:
sarah: Quick ask — can we coordinate flipping the multi-region failover toggle for model routing tonight at 23:30 UTC? Goal: enable EU->NA fallback to `redwood-llama-v2-small` for EU tenants only, with sticky-affinity TTL=24h and a 5% canary audience. Need guardrails: error-rate kill-switch, per-region QPS cap, and circuit-breaker on token errors. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/branches/feat/region-fallback-2026
liam: I'm oncall tonight. +1 for 23:30 window. What's the exact kill-switch threshold? iops/latency metrics to watch? :eyes:
ravi: Suggest kill-switch = 3x baseline error-rate OR 1.5% absolute 5xx, whichever triggers first. Also add a rolling 5m error-rate and per-minute failover limit (5/min) to avoid oscillation.
emily: I'll take the flip once the PR merges and smoke tests pass. Can we gate on these checks in the playbook? I'll run canary for 30m before ramp.
maria: QA will run two prompt sets (chat regressions + embeddings) against fallback model. I can run the smoke harness at +5 and +20 minutes post-flip. Please tag me when you flip.
jordan: Small docs note — update the Routing/Failover page with the TTL and audience rules. I'll push a short blurb after the toggle goes live.
ops-bot: [automated] Deployment window check: 23:30 UTC falls within permissible change window for EU region. No active incidents.
deploy-bot: [ci] PR build: green. infra/region-fallback-2026 passed e2e (3/3). Link: https://ci.redwood/12345
liam: OK cool. Ravi, do we need a config snippet for the flag so SRE can validate? If so post it and I'll do a quick review.
ravi: Posting the config we're going to apply in feature-store:
```json
{
  "flag": "region_failover_v2",
  "scope": {
    "regions": ["eu-west-1"],
    "tenants": "all_eu",
    "canary_percent": 5
  },
  "fallback_model": "redwood-llama-v2-small",
  "stickiness_ttl_hours": 24,
  "guardrails": {
    "error_rate_threshold_absolute": 0.015,
    "error_rate_multiplier": 3.0,
    "max_failovers_per_minute": 5
  }
}
```
emily: Looks good. Can we also add a metric tag so dashboards separate canary vs rollouts? e.g., `routing.stage=canary` on spans.
sarah: yes please add the tag. Also add a fallback log line so we can trace which requests hit fallback: `fallback_source=region_failover_v2`.
maria: QA note: when you flip, set headers for test tenants: `X-Canary: true` and `X-Test-Tenant: eu-internal` so we can isolate samples.
liam: I'll be watching prometheus and tracing. my checklist: merge PR, deploy infra, emily flips flag, smoke tests, 30m canary, then ramp to 50% EU if stable. If any threshold trips -> auto-roll back and page oncall.
emily: Ack. I'll wait for CI merge then coordinate the flip with you. tagging @maria so QA is ready.
maria: ready. Posting quick checklist to this thread when done.
deploy-bot: [deployment] infra/region-fallback-2026 deployed to staging at 1918765400. Promote to prod pending manual approval.
sarah: thanks everyone. if anything looks off during canary we abort and revert flag. I'll update stakeholders after 60m. :thumbsup:
